_note: Written by hand from each PEP title and general knowledge of the PEP, blind to the note files, the runs and every system's output, then checked by check_q1p.py and frozen before any system ran on it.
rule: One paraphrase per q1 question (the PEP title). English; 4 to 14 words; no PEP number in any form; keep names a user cannot avoid (Python, version numbers, module or keyword names); replace the title's other content words by natural synonyms or a description; never copy the title; not shaped toward any search method. Content-word overlap with the title (lowercase words of 3 or more letters, minus a short stop list, minus python, minus digits, as a share of the title's content words) must stay below 0.5.
